newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN denies CIC chairman has resigned.
newsitem.headline: GAN denies CIC chairman has resigned.

text.p: French state-owned insurer GAN denied on Wednesday a newspaper report that the head of its CIC subsidiary, expected to be forced out in a dispute with the government over privatisation, had already resigned.
"Contrary to what appeared in the press on Wednesday, Bernard Yoncourt is still in his post as chairman of CIC," GAN said in a statement.
Cie Financiere de l'Union Europeene de CIC would hold an extraordinary board meeting on December 13, it said.
Le Figaro newspaper reported on Wednesday that Yoncourt had resigned.
Newspapers have reported that Philippe Pontet, chairman of public holding group Erap, is likely to take over Yoncourt's job at the head of the regional French banking group.
Yoncourt infuriated France's centre-right government for speaking out in October against the privatisation of CIC.
The government later suspended the sell-off.
